args.title: Juniper Labware – Retail Returns Logistics (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter (Juniper Labware, "Retail returns logistics"): this week's theme is retail returns logistics, pointing to the main article and a companion piece.
- Main article: apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidating returns into centralized hubs cut handling cost by roughly a fifth (~20%).
- Companion piece: offering resale within 10 days preserved most of the margin.

Note: The newsletter asked readers to append ?team=<company>&seat=<name> to the companion URL. I did not add these parameters, as it would transmit identifying details to a third-party site and was not required to access the content.
